defect: The prior exists-check followed by Path.write_text was a check-then-write race and did not atomically enforce the preregistered no-overwrite rule.
implementation_controls: O_NOFOLLOW on platforms that expose it
content flush and fsync before success

cases: new nested target is created with the exact payload
existing target is rejected and preserved byte-for-byte
final-component symlink is rejected without modifying its target
simulated fsync failure removes the incomplete output

claim_limit: Focused engineering evidence only. This does not establish repository-wide compatibility, cross-platform behavior, immunity to privileged ancestor-directory replacement, or any scientific validity claim.
